offering_description.value: Sells body care, fragrance and home fragrance products to individual consumers through its mall-based stores and website. It designs and markets its own brand, with products made by contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: body lotions; fragrance mists; shower gels; candles; hand soaps and sanitizers

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying personal care and home fragrance products

revenue_model.value: product sales: body care, fragrance and home fragrance products sold to consumers in stores and online

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets its own products made by outside manufacturers, sold to consumers; retailer: sells its products through its own stores and website to individual consumers

geography_served.value: North America: US and Canada stores, plus online ordering

specialization.value: related lines: body care, fragrance mists, candles and home fragrance, hand soaps and sanitizers sold to the same consumers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated retail stores in shopping malls and outlet centers; online: company website for direct orders by consumers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA cosmetic labeling and safety rules, CPSC rules for candles and home fragrance products
